card.name: Just before the word inflammation
card.fires_on: Words inside or right after organ-name terms where an inflammation word is expected next, such as pericarditis, encephalitis, intraocular and orchitis.

modes.label: Inside -itis words
modes.description: Partway through a long condition name ending in -itis, where the inflammation meaning is about to complete.

modes.label: Organ word before inflammation
modes.description: An organ or location word that is directly followed by the word inflammation.

modes.label: Punctuation after an -itis term
modes.description: A bracket or colon after an -itis name, leading into a gloss of inflammation.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write inflammation words such as infl, inflammation and inflammatory.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say inflammation of a body part.
